podcast.body: This original "dancing, poppy punk song" was released in the fall of 1980 by Generation X, which was known as Gen X at the time. Its primary songwriter and performer was William Broad, who later became Billy Idol. "original version of Dancing with Myself, Billy Idol did it first when he was part of Generation X, although they were known as Gen X by the time that song came out in the fall of 1980."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song shares melodic similarities with The Strokes' 2020 single "Bad Decisions." Due to these resemblances, Billy Idol and Tony James, members of Generation X, received songwriting credits on "Bad Decisions." "Billy Eidle and Tony James of Generation X got songwriting credits because of the melodic similarities to the song Dancing With Myself."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
